summary.text: According to the legislative biography, Gregg Takayama has served in the Hawaii House of Representatives since his election in 2012 and represents the Pearl City community.

paragraphs.text: He is a graduate of Farrington High School and the University of Hawaii at Manoa, where he earned a degree in journalism.

He worked as a news reporter at KHON-TV, as press secretary to the late U.S. Senator Dan Inouye, and as communications director for the UH John A. Burns School of Medicine and later for the Manoa Chancellor.
